explanation: The value peaks at D2: about 10 when the agent chose a1 and rarely reached S2, 7-9 after a common transition (8-9 if the previous trial was unrewarded or choices have been switching, 7 during steady rewarded streaks), and only 3-6 when it chose a2 and rarely reached S1. D1 is low (3-5, up to 6 after a loss) and GO is lower still (0-3, near 0 during long rewarded a2 streaks); everything drops further late in the episode (trial 80 and later: D1 and GO near 0, common D2 about 5, a2-to-S1 rare D2 about 2).
